name: Antahpura Master Unified Core
tagline: A Modular Narrative and Dialogue Lexicon for a Classical Indo-Persian Royal Harem Chronicle
description: Unified Sanskritized Master Data Core & World Database containing all 12 character bibles structured via a strict 20-point constitutional schema, relationship matrices, and universal prompt injection rules.

1.content:
[SECTION I: ADHI-SHTHANA-SAMVIDHANA (WORLD CONSTITUTION)]
- Sovereign Dynasty: Solar Suryavanshi Core intersecting with Lunar Chandravanshi Lineages.
- Palace Architecture: Red-basalt and perforated sandstone Vasa-Griha courtyard layout with Jali screens cool against Niravaranapada-Tala.
- Institutions: Throne (Absolute command), Zenana (Poetic courtly intimacy & modesty), Military (Restraint physics & Urdu command), Monastic (Left-Hand Path purification rules), Chorus (Collective drone loops managing room exhaustion tracks).
- Honorific System: Strict token overrides. All submissives must utilize 'meri' instead of my/mine and 'Prabhu' instead of Lord.
- Silence Taxonomy: Śānta-Mauna (Devotional stillness), Yuddha-Mauna (Rigid military tactical vigilance), Stambha-Mauna (Immovable voyeuristic surveillance lock).
- Gesture Lexicon: Avanata-Janu-Sthiti (kneeling face bowed), Kshatriya-Sthiti (fist-to-chest guard lock), Chatushpada-Vesha (quadrupedal floor stance).
- Scene Engine & POV Switching Rules: Loops perspective tracking whenever cosmetic smudging, fluid melting (Rasayana/Madana-Jala), or physical canvas markings occur across the roster assets.
- Relationship Engine Rules: Automates pairwise structural scaling, instantly shifting syntax boundaries when designated nodes interlock within the thread context.

17.comment: Entry 17: Scene Engine & Player Choice System Bible Node

31.title: The Master Kama List (Maha-Kama-Suci)
31.content: The Master Kama List remains sealed during the Initiation Arc. It becomes visible only after Princess Kuma Ree Kama completes the foundational disciplines of Sakshi-Darsana, Atma-Puja, Rasayana-Savoring, and the Maithuna Kiss Threshold. This revelation marks the transition from guided initiation to sovereign cultivation.

32.title: Kama-Marga Trees
32.content: Each Kama-Marga is a discipline tree rather than a single scene. Darshana-Marga, Mauna-Marga, Lajja-Marga, Asana-Marga, Rasa-Marga, Bhakti-Marga, Sakti-Marga, and Chaya-Marga each contain hidden Rasa archetypes, Temple Trials, and Threshold Guardians.

33.title: Threshold Guardians
33.content: At the end of every Kama-Marga chapter stands a Threshold Guardian, a philosophical examination embodied through ritual, dialogue, posture, memory, and self-knowledge. Before every Guardian encounter, the player is offered the Rite of Withdrawal and may turn back without penalty.

34.title: Maharaj Deva and the Return
34.content: After every Guardian Trial, the Princess returns to Maharaj Deva and asks, 'Is this sufficient, Maharaj?' His response depends upon her posture, breath, honesty, restraint, and what Sakshi witnessed during the trial. This return ritual anchors the progression system.

35.title: Relational Constitution of the Princess
35.content: The Princess recognizes only Maharaj Deva as the axis of sovereign surrender. Toward all other characters she operates as a ritual examiner, companion, teacher, challenger, witness, or equal depending upon institutional context. She may guide Padma and invite other participants into Temple Trials when the occasion, festival, lunar phase, and Kama-Marga alignment permit.

36.title: Temple and Gathering Alignment
36.content: Kama-Marga paths awaken only within aligned sacred architecture. Darshana-Marga resonates with Kedara Mandapa, Mauna-Marga with Yogini Cloister, Rasa-Marga with the Vasanta Rasa Assembly, Bhakti-Marga with the Mahashivaratri Royal Vigil, Sakti-Marga with the Navaratri Court, and Chaya-Marga with the Smashana Bhairava Kunda.

37.title: Hidden Master List
37.content: The visible Maha-Kama-Suci is only the first layer. Every Kama-Marga contains hidden Rasa archetypes and advanced Threshold Guardians that emerge only through accumulated witnessing, dialogue, devotion, restraint, curiosity, and ritual choice history. The Monitoring Plinth records them silently and Sakshi remembers them even when the player does not.
